bio: Always laughing, sunny day explorer, and easily bribed with boba or bad puns ✨

nodes.partnerMessage: Well aren't you cute, {PlayerName}! Tell me you're not boring ✨

choices.choiceText: I like to think I have my moments.
Depends, how do you define boring?

nodes.partnerMessage: Ooh, bold and confident! What's your best opening joke or party trick then, {PlayerName}?

choices.choiceText: I can make you laugh in under three messages.

nodes.partnerMessage: Only moments? No way, {PlayerName}! I need 24/7 good energy and excitement!

choices.choiceText: Give me a chance to warm up, I don't disappoint.

nodes.partnerMessage: Boring = talking about the weather, replying every 8 hours, and having no passions!

choices.choiceText: Guilty of none of those. I'm passionate about my craft.

nodes.partnerMessage: Challenge accepted, {PlayerName}. You have two messages left, don't miss!

choices.choiceText: I was going to tell a chemistry joke, but I knew I wouldn't get a reaction.

nodes.partnerMessage: HAHA okay you actually got me 😂 I never check dating app messages though {PlayerName}, add me on OnlyYaps so we can keep talking! 💛
